stages.name: floater cleanup near the summit
stages.rule: within 8.0 model units (horizontal) of the summit shrine, remove Gaussians that are translucent air (training-weighted accumulated alpha < 0.80 and > 0.10 from any reliable surface Gaussian), float > 0.08 above the reliable-surface terrain map (and > 0.03 from any reliable Gaussian), or are detached needles (max/mid scale > 10, max scale > 0.02, > 0.05 from it); never remove a Gaussian with opacity >= 0.6 seen in >= 100 TRAIN views, nor anything inside the summit hut compound box x[-7.8,-5.6] y[-0.9,3.6] z[-2.5,-0.3]; tools/splat-cleanup-v1/apply_rule_v2.py, rule-v2.json

limitations: Not privacy-reviewed beyond the training masks.
Rows removed only; no Gaussian attribute was edited.
Haze baked into the learned sky-field texture is not a splat and is unchanged.
Far terrain splats beyond 8 model units of the shrine (cirque rim and ridges about 20-320 units away) are unchanged; they look smeared or streaky from aerial viewpoints.
The streak at the lower left of the aerial screenshot view is opaque cliff-face surface Gaussians 0.8-2.2 units east of the shrine (z -0.5 to -2.0) seen at grazing angles, not floaters; unchanged.
Opaque, well-trained Gaussians (opacity >= 0.6, >= 100 TRAIN views) and the summit hut compound are never removed, so a few floaters of that kind (and translucent layers around the hut) remain.
